scraped.scraped_description: Our vision is that every person on the planet is recognised, protected and provided for from birth

name: OpenCRVS
tagline: Open source digital civil registration and vital statistics system for every person on the planet
sdg_alignment: SDG 16 – Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
dependency_risks: Dependent on Node.js, React, and MongoDB ecosystems; requires ongoing maintenance for security updates
news_articles: OpenCRVS: Giving every person a legal identity - Digital Public Goods Alliance
Bangladesh implements OpenCRVS for digital civil registration - TechCrunch
Open source civil registration system expands across Africa - Guardian
academic_citations: OpenCRVS as a Digital Public Good for identity systems - World Bank research
Civil registration digitalization in low-resource settings - academic papers on SDG 16.9
awards: Digital Public Good recognition by DPGA
Recognized as critical infrastructure for SDG 16.9 implementation

policy_outcomes.description: Recognized as a Digital Public Good by the Digital Public Goods Alliance
Aligned with SDG 16.9 on achieving legal identity for all

outcome_methodology: Case studies and implementation reports from deploying countries; monitoring of registration coverage and system uptime
published_performance_metrics: System uptime, registration processing times, user adoption rates documented in implementation reports
documented_limitations: Requires significant local capacity building and infrastructure investment
Dependent on reliable internet connectivity in deployment contexts
Data security and privacy considerations in low-resource settings
failure_modes: System downtime in areas with unreliable power or internet
Data loss risks without proper backup infrastructure
curation_criteria: Open source contribution guidelines; code review process; alignment with SDG 16.9 objectives
contributor_governance: Community-driven development with contributions from government partners, NGOs, and individual developers; managed through GitHub
disparity_tracking: Focused on reaching marginalized populations lacking legal identity; tracks coverage in rural and underserved areas

government_partnerships.nature: Implementation of digital civil registration systems

ai_involvement: No AI/machine learning components; rule-based system for civil registration and vital statistics
political_relevance_summary: OpenCRVS addresses threats to digital rights and online privacy, providing infrastructure that protects civic freedoms in an increasingly surveilled digital environment.

movement_building_utility.notes: OpenCRVS provides foundational data infrastructure, standards, or platforms that other civic technology efforts build upon.

generalizability_notes: High generalizability. OpenCRVS is open source and already deployed across multiple countries/jurisdictions, making replication straightforward for other contexts.
